info.description: Runtime key-value config store. Strapi admin can change values without redeploying. n8n W0_CONFIG_READER fetches these and caches in Redis (TTL 60s). Secrets are marked is_secret=true (UI hides value).

key.description: Config key, e.g. LLM_MODEL. Used as lookup key in n8n W0_CONFIG_READER.

value.description: Config value as string. n8n parses booleans/numbers as needed.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this setting controls.

is_secret.description: If true, the Strapi admin UI should mask the value. Secrets are never logged.
